deployments_detail.use: AI job assistant for recruitment (text-based candidate engagement, role exploration, benefits information, applications, interview scheduling)
Subsidiary CNA uses AI/analytics for underwriting + operations; formal CNA AI governance policy (2024) — no named production system
Oracle Hospitality platform deployment and integration for Loews Hotels [Oracle Hospitality]

CNA partnered with SLK Software and AI firm V-Labs to deploy an enterprise-wide AI-led intelligent automation solution automating new business submission intake, claims and other document-heavy insurance business processes. [SLK Software + V-Labs]
deployments_detail.value: reduced average processing time in targeted areas from several hours or days to a few minutes

deployments_detail.use: CNA is driving enterprise adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio, evaluating and piloting the tools via its AI & Digital Enablement and AI Governance teams (evidenced by dedicated M365 Copilot administrator roles and an AI Governance internship piloting Microsoft 365 Copilot). [Microsoft 365 Copilot]

Loews Hotels uses Oracle Hospitality OPERA Cloud's AI-powered Guest Engagement and Merchandising, which automates routine tasks and drives personalized guest recognition, upsell/merchandising and rate optimization across its US property portfolio; use expanded in July 2026 with OPERA Cloud Central distribution and loyalty. [Oracle (OPERA Cloud Guest Engagement & Merchandising)]

CNA Insurance runs Appian's Connected Underwriting P&C Workbench, an AI-automation platform that lets underwriters and agents track policy status, issues, claims and payment status and accelerates time-to-quote across a global underwriting operation. [Appian (Connected Underwriting)]

CNA built a geospatial flood-risk assessment capability on Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataflow/geobeam, GKE) that scores property-level flood exposure (coastal, fluvial and pluvial) and feeds risk scores into underwriters' workflow, being integrated into CNA's underwriting system. [Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataflow, geobeam)]
deployments_detail.value: ~25% increase in ability to provide a comprehensive flood risk view

deployments_detail.use: CNA Canada deployed mea Platform's agentic AI Intelligent Underwriting solution for automated submission data extraction and submission logging across select lines of business, with rollout continuing across wider operations. [mea Platform (agentic AI)]

Loews Hotels & Co deployed BluIP's AIVA AI-powered conversational virtual assistant across voice, chat and messaging for its guest engagement/reservation centers, integrated with Oracle OPERA Cloud so guest context (profiles, reservations, past interactions) carries through to live agents. [BluIP AIVA + Oracle OPERA Cloud]
deployments_detail.value: over 1.1 million interactions per month; deployment began Jan 1 2025, live May 2025

deployments_detail.use: CNA Financial deployed Shift Technology's FORCE, an AI-native SaaS fraud detection solution that generates dynamic fraud scores for each claim (replacing static rules) and provides contextual guidance to special investigators. CNA was the first US-based commercial insurer to partner with Shift. [Shift Technology (FORCE)]
